## Overview
The semantic substrate provides meaning-aware processing across ASTalyzer,
Universe, and tooling. It is the foundation for documentation and module reasoning.

## Components
- Semantic graph builder  
- Canonical meaning registry  
- Type inference substrate  
- Cross-module semantic linking  

## Example Semantic Link
FunctionDef "load_schema" → Concept "Schema Loader"

## Integration
- Universe validation  
- Tooling diffing  
- DocLibrarian summarization
